## Does it belong here?

<!-- Please check before submitting: -->

- [ ] This is a change to the **static site** (UI, content, accessibility, performance, themes, routing)
- [ ] It does **not** require a backend server, database, or authentication service
- [ ] It does **not** add donation links, sponsor buttons, paywalled content, or monetization of any kind

> Feature requests that require a backend or add financial-collection features will not be accepted. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for ground rules.
